recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, warm-toned portrait of a blonde woman in profile, overlaid with diagonal light streaks and structured serif typography in the upper-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal light rays intersect the subject's face, creating a sense of movement and depth.
The left-aligned text block balances the right-heavy visual weight of the subject.
The warm, desaturated color palette unifies the skin tones, hair, and background into a cohesive sepia-like atmosphere.
coreInvariants: Diagonal light streaks at approximately 45 degrees
Soft, diffused lighting with low contrast
Left-justified text block in the upper-left corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right two-thirds of the frame, captured from the chest up in a three-quarter profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the bright diagonal light rays passing over the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold top-left text, follows the diagonal light rays down across the subject's face, and rests on the detailed hair textures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper-left area is utilized for typography, while the background remains a blurred, neutral wash.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and muted gold (skin, hair, background)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white-yellow (specular highlights in light rays)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a high-key, bright value range, creating a faded, vintage look.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and warm neutrals

letterConstructionRules: Thick vertical stems with very thin horizontal hairlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter-spacing (tracking) in the primary display text to create a block-like feel

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the neutral background area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Using different weights and cases of high-contrast serifs to create a cohesive, editorial look.
graphicDevices: Small metadata box in top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and bold stems of the display text.
Appropriate for the softer, secondary title text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a woman with blonde hair in a warm, sepia-toned environment. Apply a heavy diagonal light-leak effect with golden-white rays crossing from top-right to bottom-left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add left-aligned text in the top-left corner using a bold, high-contrast serif font in a muted taupe color. Ensure the main title is in all-caps with tight spacing.

verificationChecks: Are the light rays diagonal and soft-edged?
Is the color palette restricted to warm neutrals?
Is the font a high-contrast serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the taupe text
postGenerationChecks: Check that light rays do not obscure the text legibility.
Verify the high-contrast serif has thin enough hairlines.
Ensure the overall tone is warm and desaturated.
Confirm the text block is justified to the left margin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm-toned portrait + diagonal light leaks + high-contrast left-aligned serif typography = 70s editorial aesthetic.
